conditions.evaluated per configuration: A not run, B 40/40, C not run, D not run

fairness.name: Same samples
fairness.detail: 40 of 40 requested samples evaluated by LLM Only; no scored samples for Static Only, Static + LLM, Static + LLM + RAG (reference run 20261109T083055Z_codereviewer_msg_test_llm_only_n40)

fairness.name: Fresh LLM calls
fairness.detail: replies reused from the cache in LLM Only: quality metrics compare, times do not

fairness.name: Same evaluation rules
fairness.detail: {'comment': 'top-ranked finding: title + recommendation (variant title_fix)', 'text_metric_scale': 'BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, chrF in 0-100; coverage in 0-1'}

notes: Run all four on one sample set: python -m marl_agents.cli eval ablation --benchmark codereviewer --task msg --limit 40 --seed 42 --configurations static_only,llm_only,static_llm,static_llm_rag --config configs/gemini.yaml
n = 40: differences of a few points are within sampling noise (see the bootstrap CIs in each run's summary).
The effect of RAG on comment quality cannot be judged here: it needs Static + LLM and Static + LLM + RAG on the same samples. Static Only vs Static + LLM + RAG changes two things at once.

Gemini: set GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.6-flash first. Three LLM configurations on 40 samples need at least 120 requests, and the free tier allows 20 per day per model. Add --reuse-llm-cache and repeat the command each day: cached replies carry it forward, and the run that finishes is complete.
tables.warning: Incomplete comparison: Static Only, Static + LLM, Static + LLM + RAG have no results. This table does not show that RAG improves comment quality.
